query_analysis.original_query: What are the mass transfer rate intervals for SOx in gas sweetening using sodium hydroxide ? Please provide accurate intervals.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Determine the range of mass transfer rates for sulfur oxides (SOx) in a gas sweetening process using sodium hydroxide as the absorbent. Provide precise intervals based on process conditions and system parameters.
